statement: A republish never rewrites another publication's artifact: every catalog record's outputPath resolves to a distinct file, and the bytes at an existing record's outputPath are not modified by any later compile or republish.
reachability: LIVE — every republish reaches Republisher.republish; the MCP `republish` tool (RepublishTool, Maugham/MCP/Tools/PublicationTools.swift) is production's only caller
fix_history: Pinned the CLOBBER (a republish's staged filename echoed the ORIGINAL edition's version, so moving it into Exports/ silently destroyed the original's bytes on every republish) until fixed at 680f2ff1, 2026-08-09 — mint the version before compile, so the filename can never equal a prior record's. Hardened the same day by the branch's whole-branch review (finding I1): the minted `-r<suffix>` was random over a 65,536-value pool with no uniqueness check, and a collision's punishment was a silent removeItem of the earlier republish's artifact — the same loss, one door over. The mint now re-draws while the version is taken, and an occupied destination fails the job loudly instead of deleting.

statement: every pre-compile refusal (no config, version-without-language, no-source-version, version collision, mint-in-flight, coverage block) terminates its job as .failed and leaves nothing durable behind except the EMISSION.md refresh — no snapshot, no export, no catalog row, no version bump
a dry run mutates nothing durable except the EMISSION.md refresh and terminates in the distinct dryRunPassed job state; it neither reserves nor releases the mint gate

EMISSION.md is rewritten unconditionally on every compile and preview, refusals and dry runs included, before any guard runs — the one app-owned generated file in the publish tree, refreshed so it never misinforms an agent reading it (F5's own rationale)

a thrown error after the first durable mutation (EMISSION.md write, snapshot capture/save, the compilers, the catalog append, the version-bump save) never terminalises the job: the record stays .inProgress for the life of the process, so compile_status reports a dead compile as still compiling and the status pill spins forever
reachability: LIVE — MCP `compile` (CompileTool) -> CompileOrchestrator.compile; injected via a directory squatting on the device catalog path

statement: when the catalog append throws, the export is already in Exports/ and the snapshot is already persisted, and the error that reaches the caller (a raw internal_error with the Swift error description) names neither — the operation changed the project and the failure does not say what it did

the catalog append precedes the version-bump save, so a bump failure strands a committed publication behind an unbumped counter (the next source compile of the same format refuses with the collision guard's remedy) — the file's own recorded TODO: transactional commit
intent: INTENTIONAL — the TODO records the trade deliberately

statement: the compile path deletes whatever is at its destination filename before moving its output in, so with a filename template omitting {version} a later source compile renders the SAME filename and replaces the earlier record's bytes — that record's catalog row then points at the later edition's bytes. The republish path refuses an occupied destination; the compile path does not
reachability: LIVE — MCP `compile` (CompileTool) -> CompileOrchestrator.compile after set_publish_config removes {version} from filename_template

statement: cancellation is advisory and the terminal write wins: cancel reports cancelled and sets a token nothing polls (isCancelled has zero production callers), the compile proceeds through every mutation, and its completion OVERWRITES .cancelled with .completed — a writer told cancelled gets a published edition
reachability: LIVE — MCP compile_cancel during any compile

statement: a preview with no publish config fails its job and then returns Result(outputPath: "", errors: []) — which the tool renders as {status: completed, output_path: ""}; the 'no config' reason never reaches the caller
reachability: LIVE — MCP preview_compile on a project never initialised for publishing

statement: the maughamPublicationCompleted event has exactly one post site, in CompileOrchestrator: a republish never posts it, so the Exports pane refreshes after a compile and not after a republish — the catalog says the edition exists while the pane still answers without it
reachability: LIVE — MCP republish with the project window open
